complete.description: True only if all visible tables, their text, and their grid/header/span relationships have been faithfully recorded within the schema and output limits.

uncertain.description: Describe each unresolved reading or structural relation by observed position. Do not invent a repair.

row.description: Zero-based starting row, observed from the image.

column.description: Zero-based starting column, observed from the image.

rowSpan.description: Number of rows actually occupied by this cell; never guessed.

columnSpan.description: Number of columns actually occupied by this cell, including a visible group header.

headerRole.description: Observed cell role, independent of bold style.

text.description: Original visible UTF-8 cell text. Empty string only for an explicitly observed blank cell. Inline LaTeX may preserve visible mathematics; no whole-table LaTeX.

bold.description: Observed bold extent in this cell; mixed does not identify which characters are bold.

caption.description: Only the visible original caption, verbatim; null if no caption is visible.

rowCount.description: Actual number of logical rows you observe, including header rows. Limits are generic resource bounds, not source dimensions.

columnCount.description: Actual number of logical columns you observe, including row-label columns.
